name: HORIPAD for Nintendo Switch
summary: The controller this bridge presents itself as. Map each of its controls to whatever you want to press on your own pad.

steps.prompt: Push the stick you want as the LEFT stick fully RIGHT
Now push that same stick fully DOWN
Push the stick you want as the RIGHT stick fully RIGHT
Now push that same stick fully DOWN

controls.label: D-pad up
controls.prompt: Press what should be D-pad UP

controls.label: D-pad down
controls.prompt: Press what should be D-pad DOWN

controls.label: D-pad left
controls.prompt: Press what should be D-pad LEFT

controls.label: D-pad right
controls.prompt: Press what should be D-pad RIGHT

controls.label: X
controls.prompt: Press the button you want to act as X

controls.label: A
controls.prompt: Press the button you want to act as A

controls.label: B
controls.prompt: Press the button you want to act as B

controls.label: Y
controls.prompt: Press the button you want to act as Y

controls.label: L
controls.prompt: Press what should be the L shoulder

controls.label: R
controls.prompt: Press what should be the R shoulder

controls.label: ZL
controls.prompt: Press or squeeze what should be ZL (a trigger works too)

controls.label: ZR
controls.prompt: Press or squeeze what should be ZR (a trigger works too)

controls.label: Cap
controls.prompt: Press what should be Capture (or skip)

controls.label: Hm
controls.prompt: Press what should be Home (or skip)

controls.label: L3
controls.prompt: Press what should be a LEFT stick click

controls.label: R3
controls.prompt: Press what should be a RIGHT stick click
